label: MEASURED
what: Same question on the secure-boot hardware two ways: (a) the hand-written wrappers rtl/tops/top_<v>.v with the original engine scripts/glitchsat.py (z3), attacker input held constant, power-up from initial values, no reset; (b) examples/secure_boot with GlitchSAT bring-your-own-design: no hand-written Verilog, generated monitor, reset for 1 cycle then faults, power-up any, gscale engine.
command_a: python3 scripts/glitchsat.py check <cat of rtl files + tops/top_<v>.v> --top top_<v> --k 3 --cycles 8
